response.rationale: The presence of noncaseating granulomatous hepatitis and hypercalcemia strongly supports Sarcoidosis (D8) and Granulomatous disease-associated hypercalcemia (D6). The negative intradermal tuberculin test further supports Sarcoidosis by ruling out tuberculosis, a common cause of granulomatous disease. While D6 is also strongly supported, D8 is a more specific diagnosis given the additional information.
